About Us.

For over three decades, Dhiman Hydraulics India has been the unwavering backbone of industries that power our world. Since 1990, we are delivering hydraulic fittings, unions, and pipes that stand the test of time and pressure.

Our journey began with a simple mission: to provide not just parts, but solutions. To be the critical connection that our clients can trust without a second thought. This 30-year legacy isn't just a number—it's a testament to millions of leak-proof connections, countless hours of uninterrupted machine operation, and the deep expertise that only comes from decades of hands-on experience.
